description: PROP-001 in verification-architecture.md explicitly requires property-based tests via fast-check for overlap detection symmetry and reflexivity. The current tests are purely example-based with hand-picked values. Similarly, PROP-002 (splitEntryAtMidnight duration preservation) and PROP-003 (aggregation total preservation) are specified as Tier 3 property-based verification candidates but are tested only with example-based assertions. This means the stated verification strategy is not implemented.
recommendation: Add fast-check property-based tests for PROP-001 (arbitrary TimeRange pairs verifying symmetry, reflexivity, and correctness), PROP-002 (arbitrary entries verifying duration preservation and non-overlap of splits), and PROP-003 (arbitrary entry lists verifying aggregation total preservation). Example-based tests can remain as supplementary.
